description: This file defines a base class for asynchronous database repositories using asyncpg, providing common methods for executing SQL queries and fetching results.

classes.name: BaseRepository
classes.description: A lightweight asynchronous repository base class for executing SQL operations using asyncpg.

methods.name: Optional[asyncpg.Record] fetchrow(self, query: str, *args: Any)
methods.description: Fetches a single row from the database asynchronously using the provided SQL query.

methods.name: List[asyncpg.Record] fetch(self, query: str, *args: Any)
methods.description: Fetches multiple rows from the database asynchronously using the provided SQL query.

methods.name: Any fetchval(self, query: str, *args: Any)
methods.description: Fetches a single value from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: str execute(self, query: str, *args: Any)
methods.description: Executes a SQL command asynchronously, returning a string result.

methods.name: None executemany(self, query: str, args_seq: Sequence[Sequence[Any]])
methods.description: Executes multiple SQL commands asynchronously with a sequence of arguments.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] record_to_dict(record: Optional[asyncpg.Record])
methods.description: Converts an asyncpg.Record object to a dictionary, or returns None if the record is None.

ctags.name: execute
ctags.pattern: /^    async def execute(self, query: str, *args: Any) -> str:$/

ctags.name: executemany
ctags.pattern: /^    async def executemany(self, query: str, args_seq: Sequence[Sequence[Any]]) -> None:$/

ctags.name: fetch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def fetch(self, query: str, *args: Any) -> List[asyncpg.Record]:$/

ctags.name: fetchrow
ctags.pattern: /^    async def fetchrow(self, query: str, *args: Any) -> Optional[asyncpg.Record]:$/

ctags.name: fetchval
ctags.pattern: /^    async def fetchval(self, query: str, *args: Any) -> Any:$/
